audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gave Ornn Level 2 but 'Skill' at Levels 4-5 and Level 6, the opposite of what its own whys text and the packet chart say.
audit.why: whys[1] states neither side has an all-in at 2; whys[3] states the second E point lets Ornn knock her up before her engage is online; whys[4] states Ornn's double knock-up R beats her single-stun R. Packet chart agrees on 4-5 and disagrees only on 6, where the mechanical read is decisive.
audit.corrected: Level 2 -> Skill, Levels 4-5 -> Ornn, Level 6 -> Ornn, proposed as matched full/content pairs. Ratings unchanged.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 text said only that 'Sejuani's ultimate changes the math' without naming Glacial Prison or comparing the two ults.
audit.why: Glacial Prison is 120/105/90s and stuns the first champion hit; Call of the Forge God is 140/120/100s and knocks up twice (elemental pass, then the recast collision). The ult trade favours Ornn, but Frost Armor's slow immunity blunts the R slow component.
audit.corrected: Level 6 phase rewritten with both ult cooldowns and the Frost Armor caveat.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three mechanical errors, matching what the Sejuani-side mirror audit already found: Permafrost described as a standalone 'stun after Frost stacks' with no mention of what applies the stacks; Frost Armor's slow immunity never stated; Arctic Assault never mentioned even though Ornn's Q both grounds and creates terrain. Content layer also called Permafrost a passive ('stack permafrost passive with autos') — it is the E.
audit.why: Riot text: Permafrost 'freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks'; Winter's Wrath 'swings her mace twice... applying Frost stacks'; Fury of the North grants 'Armor and Magic Resist and immunity to slows'. Slow immunity is the decisive interaction: Ornn's Q slow and R slow are dead against a Frost-Armoured Sejuani, and the value of Q is the pillar (terrain + grounding) that denies Arctic Assault, her only gap-closer.
audit.corrected: Permafrost stated as armed by Winter's Wrath/auto Frost stacks (real timer is W at 9s rank 1, not E's 1.5s); Frost Armor slow immunity stated; Q pillar named as the answer to Arctic Assault (18s rank 1). Mirror's wording reused from Ornn's side.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere; Permafrost was treated as the punishable cooldown.
audit.why: Permafrost is 1.5s flat — untrackable as a window. The punishable cooldowns are Winter's Wrath (9/8/7/6/5s), which arms the stun, and Arctic Assault (18/16.5/15/13.5/12s), her only dash.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten around W and Q.

edits.before: Bait his key tool — brittle-proc him on the Permafrost cooldown and out-item the lane. Ornn wins the Permafrost cooldown windows.
edits.after: Frost Armor makes her slow-immune, so Q is for the pillar, not the slow — E off it for the knockup and Brittle her with Bellows Breath.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God re-engages a whole fight — and your forge prints item leads. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Sejuani's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God knocks up twice; Glacial Prison stuns once on a 120s cooldown. Trade ults and you come out ahead — but Frost Armor eats your R slow.

edits.before: Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Permafrost only stuns at max Frost stacks from her W and autos — break off before the last stack lands.

edits.before: Track Sejuani's Permafrost: Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. When it is down — W-brittle + E knockup.
edits.after: Permafrost stuns only at max Frost stacks. Your Q grounds and its pillar is terrain — both deny Arctic Assault, her only gap-closer.

edits.before: - Sejuani Permafrost: matchup-defining — Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sejuani Permafrost: 1.5s, but it needs max Frost stacks, so the real timer is Winter's Wrath at 9s rank 1. - Arctic Assault: 18s rank 1 — her only dash, and your Q pillar walls it. - Your R: 140s — kill windows only.

edits.before: Neither has a real all-in at 2; her E stun off permafrost trades evenly with your W shield.
edits.after: Neither has an all-in at 2 — Permafrost is not armed yet and Bellows Breath alone will not kill.

edits.before: Once you have Q and W you stabilize, but she has Frost Armor and her E stun — it stays a coin-flip trade.
edits.after: Q and W stabilize you, but Frost Armor gives resists and slow immunity, so your Q slow never sticks — a coin-flip.

edits.before: Land her E stun off a Frost Armor permafrost proc to lock you mid-combo
edits.after: Land Permafrost the moment her Winter's Wrath tops off your Frost stacks

edits.before: Stack permafrost passive with autos and W's percent-HP to trade your HP down
edits.after: Stack Frost with autos and Winter's Wrath until Permafrost is armed, then stun you

notes: The whole page addressed Sejuani as 'him/his' (breakdown.feeding, breakdown.mid, ahead, dontsFull, tradeGood). I only fixed pronouns in strings I was already rewriting for mechanical reasons; the rest is a champion-level pronoun sweep the applier should run separately. UNVERIFIED and therefore untouched: several content strings claim Bellows Breath grants a shield and is unstoppable mid-cast (early, whys[1] original, wants.you[2]). Riot's kit text for W says only 'Ornn advances, breathing fire. Enemies hit by the final gout of flame become Brittle' — no shield, no unstoppable. I removed the shield claim from whys[1] because I was editing it anyway, but did not assert the opposite anywhere. Ornn W's kit range of 25000 is a tooltip-parse artifact (mirror audit noted the same); I asserted nothing from it.
